p2_b2.ocr: The following data table presents insights into the perceptions of clinic staff regarding collaborative learning and knowledge sharing within the therapeutic environment. Specifically, the survey item "I am frequently taught new things by other people in this clinic" serves as a focal point for understanding interpersonal dynamics and professional development opportunities among staff members. The table categorizes responses into two distinct metrics, represented by the columns "NO." and "%," which indicate the number of respondents and the corresponding percentage who agree or disagree with the statement.

p2_b3.ocr: A strong emphasis on continuous learning is crucial in therapeutic settings, where the exchange of knowledge can directly impact patient care and outcomes. By analyzing the responses, we can identify areas where the clinic excels in fostering a culture of collaboration, as well as opportunities for improvement. Understanding these dynamics not only enhances staff engagement and satisfaction but also contributes to the overall effectiveness of therapeutic interventions. Consequently, the data presented in this table will facilitate informed discussions amongst clinic leadership regarding strategies to promote a more collaborative and knowledge-rich environment.
